title: All Inboxes in the sidebar counts important unread, and account counts can be changed or hidden
steps: With two accounts (fake data has two), show the sidebar with Control-Command-S and hover the All Inboxes row and each account's title
In Settings › General › Window › Account counts choose All unread in Inbox, then Off, then Important unread; each time look at the All Inboxes row and each account's Inbox row
Right-click All Inboxes and choose Hide count, then right-click it again and choose Show count
Press G A for All mail, then open Done from the sidebar; hover each title
expected: Important unread (default): All Inboxes shows the sum of each account's important unread and its tooltip reads All Inboxes · N important unread ⌃0; each Inbox row shows its account's count. All unread in Inbox: the whole-Inbox numbers. Off: no badge on those rows. Hide count turns counts off; Show count brings back Important unread. All mail and Done show no number; hovering gives the total.
